transcript:
Speaker A (Wife): क्या हुआ? [What happened?] 
Speaker B (Husband): फिर promotion नहीं मिला। Boss ने English में सवाल पूछे और मैं जवाब ही नहीं दे पाया। [Didn't get the promotion again. Boss asked questions in English and I couldn't even answer.] 
Speaker A (Wife): उस दिन मुझे लगा कि मैं promotion तो नहीं दिलवा सकती, लेकिन अगर मैं English सीख लूँ तो हम दोनों घर पे practice कर सकते हैं। English Seekho app में रोज़ की English है। Office situations, meeting में कैसे बोलें, सबके लिए videos हैं। दिशा मैम के साथ रोज़ practice करती हूँ। AI है, judge नहीं करती, सीधा सिखाती है। और फिर शाम में इनके साथ वही practice करती हूँ, जिससे ये भी English बोलने लगें। Now we both speak English. [That day I felt that I might not be able to get him a promotion, but if I learn English, we both can practice at home. English Seekho app has everyday English. There are videos for office situations, how to speak in meetings, everything. I practice daily with Disha Mam. It's AI, it doesn't judge, it teaches directly. And then in the evening, I practice the same with him, so that he also starts speaking English. Now we both speak English.] 
Speaker B (Husband): I finally got my promotion. 
Speaker A (Wife): बस १ रुपये में तीन दिन का trial. एक बार try करो English Seekho app. [Just a 3-day trial for 1 rupee. Try the English Seekho app once.]
